aboutGame.title: What is Rain98?
paragraphs: Rain98 is a lo-fi psychological suspense and romance adventure from C#4R4CT3R, set in a rain-soaked Tokyo in 1998. The story follows two lonely youths, including Reina Amehara, as they build a fragile bond while pursuing a ritual meant to end the world.

The free Steam demo runs over three hours and covers the opening through the first half of Chapter 2. It blends visual novel dialogue, city exploration, minigames such as Daifugo, and an Angel Passport sticker book built around 100 activities.

modules.name: Rain98 Beginner Guide
modules.description: Plan your first Rain98 session around the three-hour demo, from audio and text settings to save habits and exploration pacing.

highlights.detail: Set subtitles and a slow-to-medium text speed before the opening scene.
Use headphones so the rain, ambience, and Reina's voice carry the intended mood.
Play in dim light rather than darkness to preserve the warm-room and cold-window contrast.
Keep each session around 45 to 60 minutes so the heavier themes have room to land.
Save manually at scene breaks and keep skip-read-text disabled.
Sweep each explorable area and exhaust dialogue before advancing the scene.

highlights.label: Stickers

highlights.label: Choices

highlights.label: Save
highlights.detail: Manual saves before weighted conversations make it easier to compare outcomes later.

modules.name: Rain98 Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Practical habits for preserving Rain98's atmosphere and catching the details that make its story land.

highlights.label: Headphones
highlights.detail: Listen for shifts in rain volume and rhythm; the soundscape signals scene turns.

highlights.label: Slow Read
highlights.detail: Let voice lines and internal monologue finish instead of scanning for the next choice.

highlights.label: Save Early
highlights.detail: Create a manual save before conversations that feel weighted or likely to change a relationship.

highlights.label: Take Notes
highlights.detail: Log one line per scene: who spoke, what changed, and what Reina avoided saying.

highlights.label: Explore
highlights.detail: Clear optional interactions and accessible city areas before triggering the next story beat.

highlights.label: Short Runs
highlights.detail: Split the three-hour demo into 45-to-60-minute sittings to avoid emotional fatigue.

faq.title: Rain98 Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about Rain98's story, demo, characters, platforms, choices, and code status.

items.question: What is Rain98?
items.answer: Rain98 is a lo-fi psychological suspense and romance adventure from C#4R4CT3R, set in rainy Tokyo in 1998. The story follows two lonely youths, including Reina Amehara, as their choices shape a ritual meant to end the world.

items.question: Is the Rain98 demo free?
items.answer: Yes. The Rain98 demo is free on Steam and launched on October 16, 2026. It runs over three hours and covers the opening through the first half of Chapter 2.

items.question: What platforms can I play Rain98 on?
items.answer: Windows PC via Steam is the only confirmed Rain98 platform. The free demo is available now, while the full game is planned for 2026.

items.question: Do choices matter in Rain98?
items.answer: The developers say the choices of the two leads will change the world. Rain98 uses dialogue replies, exploration, minigames, and sticker objectives to build the relationship and set up multiple outcomes.

items.question: Who is Reina Amehara?
items.answer: Reina Amehara is the emotional center of Rain98, voiced by Rio Tsuchiya. She is found in the protagonist's 1998 apartment and wants everything to end, setting the ritual in motion.

items.question: Are there Rain98 codes?
items.answer: No official redeemable codes have been announced for Rain98. The free Steam demo is the only confirmed playable build, so there is no code redemption system to use right now.
